title: Aureline presentation speaker note
description: Canonical, export-safe speaker-note object for an M5 presentation or walkthrough session. A speaker note is a presenter-only prompt attached to one waypoint. Notes default to a local scope and only become shared through an explicit, separately recorded promotion: a local-scoped note never carries a promotion marker, and a shared-scoped note always does. The human-readable body_label lives on the in-memory model and the reviewable fixtures; support, diagnostics, and telemetry exports carry only the presence flag and posture, never the raw note body. Adding a new scope value is additive-minor and requires a schema_version bump on the owning session; repurposing an existing value is breaking.

allOf.comment: A local note never carries an explicit-promotion marker.
A shared note must carry an explicit-promotion marker.
